title: Esses sidecar document (sidecar-1)
description: The per-log edit file <log>.<ext>.sidecar.json written next to a log (02_DATA_MODEL.md section 5, D-015). It holds the user's edits per data layer: details, user markers, marker edits, range overrides, local maths, annotations and video links, plus a source block that identifies the log. Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved verbatim (02 section 6.1 Document<T>::unknown); every nested record is closed, because its unknown members could not survive a typed round trip. Optional members are omitted when absent; null is never written.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

edited.description: Time of the last committed edit, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

layers.description: Edits keyed by data-layer name. The canonical name of the main layer is "Normal"; the empty alias "" is accepted on import from other formats only and is never a sidecar key (02 section 4.2 behaviour 4).

source.description: Identity of the log the edits belong to (02 section 5.3 rule 1). A quick-hash match applies the sidecar regardless of path; a mismatch applies it with the Import Log warning sidecar.source_changed.

path.description: Path of the log relative to the sidecar's directory.

size.description: Size of the log in bytes.

hash.description: Quick content hash, the SourceId (05 section 1.1).

contentHash.description: Full-content xxh3-128, added on the first save after the Background task has computed it.

companions.description: Companion file names found beside the log when the sidecar was written.

layerEdits.description: SidecarLayer (02 section 5.1). Every member is optional; an empty layer may be omitted.

details.description: User detail edits (prov User, not written).

markerEdits.description: Edits of logged and companion markers. Restore is a command, never a record: at most one offset and one ignore per marker id and at most one offsetDistance per layer (02 section 4.3 behaviours 7 and 7a; checked by the loader, not by this schema).

runs.description: Reserved for the drag profile (v1.0); preserved verbatim.

stages.description: Reserved for the rally profile (v1.0); preserved verbatim.

id.description: Detail id: a standard id of 02 section 4.2 behaviour 2 ("Driver", "Diff Ratio", ...) or a custom one.

original.description: The file's (or companion's) value that this edit replaces.

userMarker.description: A marker in the shared vocabulary whose provenance is User (02 section 5.1).

markerEdit.description: MarkerEdit (02 section 4.3). offset moves a marker by dtUs, ignore disables it, offsetDistance moves every BCN of the layer by a track distance and has no ref.

dM.description: Distance, positive = beacon further along the track.

rangeOverride.description: RangeOverride (02 section 5.1, section 5.3 rule 5): matched by (group, startMarker), then by (group, name). It carries at least one of trusted, offsetUs and offsetM; an override with none of them is removed instead of written.

offsetUs.description: Alignment offset in the time domain.

offsetM.description: Alignment offset in the distance domain, metres.

localMaths.description: A complete maths-1 module with id "local" (03 section 4.1). Only its envelope is checked here; the module body is validated against maths-1, which arrives in M2.

annotation.description: Annotation (02 section 5.1, section 5.3 rule 6): an absolute Main-source time, never range-relative.

file.description: Media file path, relative to the sidecar's directory.

syncPoints.description: Pairs [log time, media presentation time], both in microseconds.

marker.description: One marker in the key vocabulary shared by sidecar-1, markers-1 and probe-1 (02 section 5.3 rule 8). An absent flags means 0. Device events are markers of class DeviceEvent in group DeviceEvents (02 section 4.3).

group.description: "" for intrinsic markers (SOL, EOL, RESET), "Beacons", "StageMarkers", "DeviceEvents" or a companion group name.

markerClass.description: MarkerClass (02 section 4.3). Companion marker classes outside this list are not markers: they stay opaque (05 section 4 rule 1).

detailValue.description: DetailValue (02 section 4.2): text, a number with an optional unit symbol and display decimals, or a date-time. A bare string is the short form of a text value that probe-1 writes (05 section 1.2); sidecar-1 writes the tagged form (02 section 5.2).

quantityValue.description: A persisted number with a physical unit (02 conventions): {"v": number, "unit": symbol}.

unitSymbol.description: A unit symbol or alias of the unit registry (units-1), without leading or trailing white space.

hash128.description: xxh3-128 as "xxh3:" + 32 lower-case hex digits, high word first (Hash128::hex()).

flags32.description: Unsigned 32-bit flag word, passed through uninterpreted.

fileName.description: A bare file name relative to the log's directory: no directory separators.

isoDateTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and a UTC offset (or Z).

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
